jobs.prompt: Original instrumental anime arcade fighting-game character selection music. Bright electric guitar riffs, punchy bass, energetic drums, heroic synth brass, playful competitive energy, 148 BPM. Confident memorable original melody, no vocals, no speech, no existing game or anime melody. Steady groove, clean loop-friendly ending without a long fade. For Comfy Fighter Z.

Original instrumental 1990s battle-anime fighting-game theme for The Yard: A wholly fictional neighborhood backyard tournament arena at golden hour. A broad warm terracotta patio forms an empty level fighting plane; behind it sit a low cream picket fence, a red garden shed, distant soft rounded hills, a small barbecue far behind the action and simple string lights. The setting is an invented suburban garden, unrelated to any actual venue or photograph. No people, identifying signs, logos or floor emblems. Keep foreground furniture out of the arena and all image edges free of graphic speed lines. Fast electric guitar, tight breakbeat drums, driving bass, triumphant synth lead and energetic orchestral stabs, 162 BPM. Upbeat, dramatic and playful. No vocals or speech, no existing game or anime melody. Steady full-energy groove with a clean loop-friendly ending.

jobs.characterDescription: A completely invented cheerful barbecue dad in his late forties. Short, broad, powerful build with a round expressive face, warm brown skin, a bald head and a compact triangular auburn beard. Wears a brick-red sleeveless utility apron over a cream short-sleeve shirt, navy work trousers, oversized orange heatproof wrist cuffs and dark brown ankle boots. The apron ends above the knees, leaving both legs clearly visible. No hat, handheld utensils, lettering or loose accessories. His low boxing guard and bright grin give him a friendly powerhouse silhouette.

specialMove.name: Sizzle Burst
specialMove.description: Griddle plants both boots, twists his torso and thrusts one open orange-cuffed palm toward the right, releasing a compact orange-and-gold flame ball. The free hand guards his chest. Keep the fire close to the forward palm so the game can launch a separate projectile; preserve the entire body and both feet inside the sprite cell.

jobs.prompt: [excited, powerful arcade announcer, crisp and energetic] Magnet Crash!
jobs.characterDescription: A completely invented workshop dad in his early fifties. Tall muscular build, deep umber skin, a long angular face, short silver tightly curled hair and an assertive half-smile. Indigo mechanic's jumpsuit with sleeves rolled to the elbows, a wide copper belt, compact copper forearm bracers and steel-gray work boots. Simple uncluttered silhouette with no tools hanging from the belt, no goggles, no hat and no writing. His grounded open-hand guard suggests precision and strength.

specialMove.name: Magnet Crash
specialMove.description: Rivet draws both bracers together at the waist and drives one palm toward the right, launching a tight cyan magnetic pulse with three small copper fragments orbiting its center. Keep the effect near the palm, the other arm guarding the body and every limb fully inside the sprite cell. No large floating tools or duplicated arms.

jobs.prompt: [excited, powerful arcade announcer, crisp and energetic] Beat Drop!
jobs.characterDescription: A completely invented music-teacher parent in their late thirties. Compact athletic build, light olive skin, a heart-shaped face, short coral-red swept pixie hair and expressive dark eyebrows. Cropped magenta track jacket over a plain cream shirt, tapered midnight-blue trousers, cream high-top sneakers and two simple violet padded wristbands. A small pair of rounded headphones rests snugly at the collar without a loose cable. Lively upright kickboxing guard; no handheld instrument, brand marks or green accents.

specialMove.name: Beat Drop
specialMove.description: Tempo pivots on the back foot, brings both palms together and pushes them toward the right to launch one compact magenta-and-violet sound ring. A short pair of concentric rings stays near the hands. Keep the face, complete body and both shoes visible without duplicated silhouettes or musical-note lettering.

jobs.prompt: [excited, powerful arcade announcer, crisp and energetic] Cloudburst Palm!
jobs.characterDescription: A completely invented community-garden mom in her mid forties. Medium-height sturdy build, golden-brown skin, a square kind face, a thick cream-colored braid tucked into a short loop at the back of the head, and a determined smile. Plum-purple short-sleeve work coveralls, a broad lavender waist sash with short tucked ends, pale blue fitted forearm cuffs and dark violet rain boots. No plants carried on the body, trailing fabric, watering can, hat, green clothing or lettering. A calm balanced martial-arts stance with open hands.

specialMove.name: Cloudburst Palm
specialMove.description: Nimbus lowers her center of gravity and extends the forward palm toward the right, forming a compact lavender cloud surrounded by pale blue water droplets. The opposite hand remains tucked near the ribs. Confine all droplets near the attacking palm; do not hide the face or crop either rain boot.

jobs.prompt: [excited, powerful arcade announcer, crisp and energetic] Express Pulse!
jobs.characterDescription: A completely invented bicycle-courier dad in his early forties. Tall lean build, cool dark-brown skin, a narrow expressive face, shaved head and a thin silver eyebrow notch. Wears a smooth amber bicycle helmet with open face and no visor, a bright yellow fitted windbreaker, maroon tapered riding trousers, navy fingerless gloves and navy-and-yellow trainers. No bicycle, bag, loose straps, glasses or brand marks. A light forward-leaning boxing guard and springy stance create a fast angular silhouette.

specialMove.name: Express Pulse
specialMove.description: Switchback lunges with a sharp forward palm toward the right and releases a compact golden arrow-shaped energy pulse. Two short yellow motion streaks hug the attacking forearm. Keep one body only, with the rear foot planted and all helmet, gloves and shoes safely inside the sprite cell.

jobs.prompt: [excited, powerful arcade announcer, crisp and energetic] Foundation Break!
jobs.characterDescription: A completely invented neighborhood caretaker granddad in his early sixties. Very tall square heavyweight build, pale freckled skin, a broad rectangular face, flat silver crew cut and thick silver handlebar moustache. Wears a sleeveless rose-red quilted work vest over a charcoal fitted shirt, sand-colored work trousers, simple dark red knuckle wraps and chunky charcoal boots. No tools, cape, hat or lettering. A wide upright wrestling guard, massive shoulders and a warm stubborn grin make an unmistakable blocky silhouette.

specialMove.name: Foundation Break
specialMove.description: Brick braces his wide stance and drives both wrapped hands forward toward the right, launching one compact rose-red block of energy edged in pale gold. The effect resembles a solid pressure wave rather than actual building debris. Preserve one complete fighter, both boots and the entire forward reach inside the sprite cell.
